digest.component_or_area: DC sub-task parent synchronization and hierarchy management
propositions: A sub-task parent edit diverges from DC (changed locally but silently ignored remotely) with no operator-visible signal, violating the project contract that a pass must record divergence durably.

The three failing test cells assert operations the Jira DC platform does not support (accept-and-ignore on sub-task parent, silent 400 on null), making them wrong oracles rather than symptoms of a rebar defect.

The emit-side suppression of a non-epic parent (outbound_field_diff:138-139) returns identically to 'unbound, retry next pass', rendering the bridge_alerts apparatus structurally unreachable and the pass reports false convergence.

Re-homing the three cells to the already-supported Epic Link mechanism on non-sub-task children (which round-trips green in live run 30951453979) preserves the user-visible contract while fixing wrong oracles.
A user setting a parent the tracker cannot represent must see a bridge alert naming the reason and the supported alternative, never a silent no-op reporting success.
